cases.name: Brandi Suzanne Hauck
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Brandi enlisted in the U.S. Marine Corps as an Aircraft Mechanic and served her country honorably in active duty from 2011-2016, attaining the rank of Sgt, and earning numerous awards including a Global War on Terrorism Expeditionary Medal (Bahrian) and Service Medal, and a Sea Service Deployment Ribbon. She made many impactful friendships during her time in the Marine Corps. In 2019, she began college at Penn State, majoring in Mechanical Engineering. She will receive her Bachelor's Degree posthumously. She was expected to graduate in May 2024 and begin working at TE Connectivity following graduation. While attending college she loved working at the White Oak Tavern. Her family is so proud of her accomplishments.
Brandi loved her family, friends, and pets fervently (especially her dog, Petey). Her beautiful smile and laugh were loved by all who knew her. She was an avid reader, loved tattoos, animals, Harry Potter, The Office, and Disney. She cherished her friendships and was always up for having a good time with a Miller Lite in her hand."
